related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.
related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign

source_session_context.work_intent_goal: capture a read-only Monitor sample to verify environmental capability evidence

outcome.interpretation: The selected read-only Monitor capability produced a privacy-minimized sample that the Environment projection correlated to the source session objective and exact invocation events. Aggregate memory and load facts were measured; CPU utilization remained explicitly unavailable. The top-level projection was partial because the source verifier campaign had no persisted campaign ledger; its authenticated session sample remained available. One host snapshot supports a capability and measurement-availability observation, not a resource-pressure or agent-consumption claim.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Store-backed Monitor samples are absent from session capability intelligence
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: mncs-environment capability-intelligence projection and System Monitor artifact integration
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The baseline capability-intelligence source at f345d619b442ec16cb549c68fb791caef911af9f contains no System Monitor resource-sample artifact reader or projection adapter. A real read-only Monitor artifact and its exact session invocation/completion events are now available, but the baseline projection had no path to expose that evidence or relate it to the session objective. This is a structural integration finding from source comparison, not a historical claim that prior agents were blocked.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Expose the newest bounded Store-backed Monitor sample per session binding through the existing capability-intelligence projection, correlate it to invocation and completion events by provider request identity and exact artifact reference, retain objective and environment context, and distinguish measured, derived, and unavailable fields.
